(module scope)

Recursive async generator over a dropped FileSystemEntry — a folder drop yields one {file, rel} per descendant, preserving the relative path so the server rebuilds the same tree inside the ZIP. Directory readers return entries in batches of ≤100, so the do/while drains until an empty batch signals the end.

fmtBytes

Humanizes a byte count — MB above 1MB (1 decimal), KB below (min 1KB so 0-byte files don't print "0 KB").
